To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the adaptive reuse of existing buildings can be a valuable educational tool in the training of (interior architects).

the three schools have developed a shared vision of adaptive reuse as an essential part of (interior design) education, that the schools have a common educational approach to projects within their respective Masters programs that focus on adaptive reuse, and that this educational approach includes a common understanding of the concept of 'interiority' in the design studio, a common method of reading the character and the qualities of existing spaces through a process of research, and making interventions that include communication of the design process.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and implementation of a pedagogy that focuses upon the interior as a conceptual term and a category of space; and that considers adaptive reuse as a key aspect of (interio)r architecture.
the development of a pedagogical approach to the education of the interior architect.
the development of the discipline of (interior architecture) as a means of rethinking the role of architecture and design within the built environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interiority of a space is the result of the relationship between the building and its environment.

the interior approach to architecture is not only a way to understand and to deal with the existing built environment, but also to develop a sustainable and socially responsible approach to architecture.
adaptive reuse is not only a new approach to design, but it is a new way of thinking about architecture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the interior approach to education and adaptive reuse is a process that is based upon the idea that the interior of a building is not simply a category of space (i.e. the inside), but it is a concept that is based upon a radical shift in the approach to the discipline.
adaptive reuse is an important aspect of the discipline of architecture and that it is essential that students of the profession are trained in this approach.

the interiority of the existing building is not only a starting point for the design process, but it also provides the basis for a new architectural language and the creation of a new identity for the building.
The main takeaway from our work is that
adaptive reuse is not a separate category of design but a method of working that is essential to the practice of architecture.
the interior is a conceptual and theoretical approach to the discipline and that this approach can be taught.
the adaptive reuse of existing buildings is a powerful tool for the education of (interior architects).
